scope: Theorem 1.4 (Uniform bounded height) of the manuscript “Quasi-isometric recognition of virtually polycyclic groups” (preprints/quasi-isometric-recognition-of-virtually-polycyclic-groups-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 255 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c7261a742d7ca883), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let G be a connected simply connected real-triangulable unimodular Lie group, with a fixed left invariant Riemannian metric, exponential height map π : G → W, and a fixed norm on W. There is a finite subgroup AG ≤ GL(W) such that, for every K ≥ 1 and C ≥ 0, there is a constant B = B(G, K, C) with the following property. Every (K, C) self quasi-isometry F of G has an AF ∈ AG satisfying πF(g) − πF(1) − AF π(g) ≤ B (g ∈ G). (1.1)
